items.skeleton: on the eve of A, people + return + to reunite

items.zh: 由于北方水资源短缺，南水北调工程把长江流域的水输送到北方，缓解了居民生活和工业用水的压力。
items.reference: Because northern China lacks water, the South-to-North Water Diversion carries water from the Yangtze basin to the north, easing pressure on household and industrial use.
variants: The project moves water north from the Yangtze to relieve shortages that have long affected homes and factories in the north.
items.skeleton: because A lacks water, the project + carries + to B, easing + pressure

items.zh: 洋山港通过跨海大桥与大陆相连，货物可以快速运往各地，上海港口的吞吐能力也因此得到提升。
items.reference: Yangshan Port is linked to the mainland by a sea-crossing bridge, so goods can be moved quickly and Shanghai's handling capacity has improved.
variants: A bridge connects the island port to the mainland, allowing fast transport of goods and raising Shanghai's port capacity.
items.skeleton: the port + is linked + by a bridge, so goods + move and capacity + improves

items.zh: 在线教育让偏远地区的学生接触到优质课程，但长时间面对屏幕也带来了疲劳和注意力下降的问题。
items.reference: Online education gives students in remote areas access to quality courses, but long hours in front of a screen also cause fatigue and poor concentration.
variants: While online learning brings good courses to distant places, staring at a screen for too long makes students tired and less focused.
items.skeleton: online education + gives + access, but long screen time + causes + problems

items.zh: 竹编、竹刻等传统手工艺流传至今，成为地方文化的重要组成部分，并在近年重新受到市场关注。
items.reference: Traditional crafts such as bamboo weaving and carving have survived to this day, become an important part of local culture and recently regained market attention.
variants: Bamboo weaving and carving are still practised today; they form part of local identity and have drawn fresh interest from buyers.
items.skeleton: crafts + have survived, become + part of culture and regained + attention

items.zh: 一些设计师把传统竹艺与现代设计结合，让竹子走进城市生活，也为手艺人带来了新的收入。
items.reference: Some designers combine traditional bamboo craft with modern design, bringing bamboo into city life and giving craftspeople new income.
variants: By blending old bamboo techniques with contemporary design, designers have brought the material into urban homes and created work for artisans.
items.skeleton: designers + combine + A with B, bringing + and giving +

items.zh: 中国航天事业经过几十年的发展，取得了举世瞩目的成就，也培养了大批年轻的科研人员。
items.reference: After decades of development, China's space programme has achieved remarkable results and trained a large number of young researchers.
variants: China's space industry has grown over several decades, producing major achievements and a new generation of scientists.
items.skeleton: after decades, the programme + has achieved + results and trained + researchers

items.zh: 远程医疗的普及极大地方便了患者就诊。
items.reference: The spread of remote medicine has made it much easier for patients to see a doctor.
variants: Remote medical services have greatly improved access to care for patients.
items.skeleton: the spread + has made it easier + for patients + to see a doctor

items.zh: 港口的自动化程度不断提高，人工操作明显减少。
items.reference: The level of automation at the port has kept rising, and manual work has fallen noticeably.
variants: As the port becomes more automated, the need for manual labour has declined sharply.
items.skeleton: automation + has risen, and manual work + has fallen

items.zh: 随着环保意识的增强，竹制品的需求逐年上升。
items.reference: As environmental awareness grows, demand for bamboo products rises year by year.
variants: Growing concern for the environment has led to increasing demand for goods made of bamboo.
items.skeleton: as awareness + grows, demand + rises

items.zh: 大湾区城市之间的合作日益密切。
items.reference: Cooperation among cities in the Greater Bay Area is becoming increasingly close.
variants: Cities in the Greater Bay Area are working together more closely than before.
items.skeleton: cooperation + is becoming + close

items.zh: 北斗系统的建成提高了中国在导航领域的技术自主性。
items.reference: The completion of the BeiDou system has increased China's technological independence in navigation.
variants: With BeiDou in place, China relies less on foreign technology for navigation.
items.skeleton: the completion + has increased + independence

items.zh: 南水北调工程对北方地区的生态产生了深远影响。
items.reference: The South-to-North Water Diversion has had a profound impact on the ecology of northern China.
variants: The project has deeply affected the environment in the north.
items.skeleton: the project + has had + an impact on + ecology

items.zh: 水墨画讲究留白，给观者留下想象的空间。
items.reference: Traditional ink painting values blank space, leaving room for the viewer's imagination.
variants: In Chinese ink paintings, empty areas are deliberately left to invite the viewer to imagine.
items.skeleton: ink painting + values + blank space, leaving + room

items.zh: 端午节吃粽子、赛龙舟，纪念爱国诗人屈原。
items.reference: At the Dragon Boat Festival, people eat zongzi and hold dragon boat races to commemorate the patriotic poet Qu Yuan.
variants: The Dragon Boat Festival is marked by eating rice dumplings and racing dragon boats in memory of Qu Yuan.
items.skeleton: people + eat + and hold + races to commemorate +

items.zh: 高铁速度快、准点率高，已经成为许多人出行的首选。
items.reference: High-speed rail is fast and punctual, and it has become the first choice for many travellers.
variants: Because it is quick and reliable, high-speed rail is now preferred by many passengers.
items.skeleton: high-speed rail + is + and has become + the first choice

items.zh: 直播带货帮助农民把水果直接卖给消费者，减少了中间环节。
items.reference: Live-stream selling helps farmers sell fruit directly to consumers and reduces the number of middlemen.
variants: Through live streaming, farmers can reach buyers themselves, cutting out intermediaries.
items.skeleton: live-stream selling + helps + farmers + sell directly and reduces +

items.zh: 中国空间站向国际合作伙伴开放，体现了合作共赢的理念。
items.reference: China's space station is open to international partners, reflecting the idea of win-win cooperation.
variants: By welcoming foreign partners, China's space station embodies a spirit of mutual benefit.
items.skeleton: the station + is open + to partners, reflecting +

items.zh: 无人机在农业、物流和救援等领域得到广泛应用。
items.reference: Drones are widely used in fields such as agriculture, logistics and rescue.
variants: Agriculture, delivery and emergency rescue are among the many areas where drones are now common.
items.skeleton: drones + are used + in fields

items.zh: 京剧融合了唱、念、做、打四种表演形式。
items.reference: Peking opera combines four performance forms: singing, recitation, acting and acrobatic fighting.
variants: Singing, spoken dialogue, movement and martial arts are all part of Peking opera.
items.skeleton: Peking opera + combines + four forms

items.zh: 中秋节象征团圆，人们在这一天赏月、吃月饼。
items.reference: The Mid-Autumn Festival symbolizes reunion, and people admire the moon and eat mooncakes on that day.
variants: On the Mid-Autumn Festival, families gather to watch the full moon and share mooncakes, a symbol of reunion.
items.skeleton: the festival + symbolizes + reunion, and people + admire + and eat +

items.zh: 书法讲究笔画的力度与整体的气韵。
items.reference: Calligraphy stresses the strength of each stroke and the overall spirit of the work.
variants: In calligraphy, both the power of individual strokes and the rhythm of the whole piece matter.
items.skeleton: calligraphy + stresses + strength and spirit

items.zh: 中医强调人与自然的平衡，注重预防而非只治病。
items.reference: Traditional Chinese medicine emphasizes balance between people and nature and focuses on prevention rather than merely treating illness.
variants: Rather than only curing disease, Chinese medicine stresses harmony with nature and the prevention of illness.
items.skeleton: Chinese medicine + emphasizes + balance and focuses on + prevention

items.zh: 四合院是北京传统民居的代表，体现了家族聚居的生活方式。
items.reference: The courtyard house is a representative form of traditional Beijing housing and reflects the way extended families lived together.
variants: Traditional Beijing courtyard homes show how several generations of a family once shared a single compound.
items.skeleton: the courtyard house + is + a representative form and reflects +

items.zh: 丝绸之路不仅是贸易通道，也是东西方文化交流的桥梁。
items.reference: The Silk Road was not only a trade route but also a bridge for cultural exchange between East and West.
variants: More than a trading route, the Silk Road connected Eastern and Western cultures.
items.skeleton: the Silk Road + was not only + a route but also + a bridge

items.zh: 中国的高铁运营里程居世界前列，超过四万公里。
items.reference: China's high-speed rail network is among the longest in the world, covering more than 40,000 kilometres.
variants: With over 40,000 kilometres in operation, China ranks near the top globally for high-speed rail.
items.skeleton: the network + is among the longest + covering + kilometres

items.zh: 与十年前相比，农村地区的网络覆盖率大幅提高。
items.reference: Compared with ten years ago, network coverage in rural areas has increased substantially.
variants: Rural areas now have much wider internet access than they did a decade ago.
items.skeleton: compared with ten years ago, coverage + has increased

items.zh: 这座跨海大桥全长数十公里，连接了三座城市。
items.reference: The sea-crossing bridge stretches for dozens of kilometres and links three cities.
variants: Dozens of kilometres long, the bridge across the sea connects three cities.
items.skeleton: the bridge + stretches + and links + cities

items.zh: 今年上半年，该港口的集装箱吞吐量比去年同期增长了百分之八。
items.reference: In the first half of this year, the port's container throughput rose by eight percent compared with the same period last year.
variants: The port handled eight percent more containers in the first six months than a year earlier.
items.skeleton: throughput + rose + by eight percent

items.zh: 中国人口老龄化速度加快，六十五岁以上人口比例持续上升。
items.reference: China's population is ageing faster, and the share of people aged 65 and above keeps rising.
variants: The proportion of Chinese citizens over 65 continues to climb as the population ages more quickly.
items.skeleton: the population + is ageing + and the share + keeps rising
info_points: 六十五岁以上比例上升

items.zh: 无人机喷洒农药的效率大约是人工的数倍。
items.reference: Spraying pesticide by drone is several times more efficient than doing it by hand.
variants: A drone can apply pesticide several times faster than a person working manually.
items.skeleton: spraying by drone + is + several times more efficient

items.zh: 必须看到，农村电商的发展仍面临不少困难。
items.reference: It must be recognized that rural e-commerce still faces many difficulties.
variants: Rural e-commerce, for all its progress, continues to face considerable obstacles.
items.skeleton: it must be recognized + that + e-commerce + faces + difficulties

items.zh: 要进一步加强对传统文化的保护，让年轻人了解它的价值。
items.reference: Efforts should be made to strengthen the protection of traditional culture and help young people understand its value.
variants: Traditional culture needs stronger protection so that young people can appreciate what it is worth.
items.skeleton: efforts + should be made + to strengthen + and help +

items.zh: 应鼓励企业加大研发投入，提高自主创新能力。
items.reference: Companies should be encouraged to increase investment in research and development and improve their capacity for independent innovation.
variants: Policymakers should push firms to spend more on R&D and develop their own technologies.
items.skeleton: companies + should be encouraged + to increase + and improve +

items.zh: 只有通过长期监测，才能及时发现工程带来的生态变化。
items.reference: Only through long-term monitoring can ecological changes caused by the project be identified in time.
variants: Ecological effects of the project will be detected promptly only if monitoring continues over many years.
items.skeleton: only through monitoring + can changes + be identified

items.zh: 要在保持各自特色的同时，推动区域深度融合。
items.reference: Regional integration should be promoted while each area's distinctive features are preserved.
variants: Deeper regional cooperation should go hand in hand with keeping local identities.
items.skeleton: integration + should be promoted + while features + are preserved

items.zh: 要坚持节水优先，把水资源管理放在更重要的位置。
items.reference: Priority should be given to saving water, and water resource management should be placed higher on the agenda.
variants: Water conservation must come first, with management of water resources treated as a greater priority.
items.skeleton: priority + should be given + and management + placed higher

items.zh: 竹子生长迅速，用途广泛，它既可以建房，也可以制作乐器。
items.reference: Bamboo grows quickly and has many uses: it can be used both to build houses and to make musical instruments.
variants: Because bamboo grows fast and is so versatile, people use it for everything from housing to musical instruments.
items.skeleton: bamboo + grows + and has uses: it + can be used +

items.zh: 北斗系统为用户提供定位服务，其信号在城市和山区都较稳定。
items.reference: The BeiDou system provides positioning services, and its signal is relatively stable in both cities and mountains.
variants: BeiDou offers location services and maintains a fairly reliable signal in urban and mountainous areas.
items.skeleton: the system + provides + services, and its signal + is stable

items.zh: 传统婚礼的细节因地区而异，但它们都强调家庭团圆。
items.reference: The details of traditional weddings vary from region to region, but they all emphasize family reunion.
variants: Although wedding customs differ across regions, all of them stress the reunion of the family.
items.skeleton: details + vary + but they + emphasize + reunion

items.zh: 港口通过跨海大桥与大陆相连，这使货物运输更加便捷。
items.reference: The port is connected to the mainland by a sea-crossing bridge, which makes the transport of goods more convenient.
variants: A bridge links the port to the mainland, allowing goods to move more easily.
items.skeleton: the port + is connected + by a bridge, which makes + convenient

items.zh: 许多患者使用远程问诊，这为他们节省了大量时间。
items.reference: Many patients use online consultations, which saves them a great deal of time.
variants: Online consultations save many patients a lot of time.
items.skeleton: patients + use + consultations, which saves + time

items.zh: 年轻人把传统竹艺与现代设计结合，这为手艺人带来了新的机会。
items.reference: Young people combine traditional bamboo craft with modern design, which brings new opportunities to craftspeople.
variants: By mixing old bamboo techniques with contemporary design, young designers create fresh chances for artisans.
items.skeleton: young people + combine + A with B, which brings + opportunities
